metadata.name: Amine's default config (essentials)
metadata.description: Streaming-platform catalogs plus 4K-first French and English streams, with no addon that needs a URL of your own.
metadata.author: personal-os-setup

config.addonDescription: AIOStreams — one addon, all your sources

dynamicAddonFetching.condition: ((count(cached(resolution(regexMatched(totalStreams), '2160p'))) >= 1) or (count(cached(resolution(regexMatched(totalStreams), '1440p'))) >= 1) or ((count(cached(resolution(regexMatched(totalStreams), '1080p'))) >= 2) and (count(cached(resolution(totalStreams, '2160p','1440p'))) == 0)) or ((count(cached(resolution(regexMatched(totalStreams), '720p','576p','480p','360p','240p','144p'))) >= 3) and (count(cached(resolution(totalStreams, '2160p','1440p','1080p'))) == 0)) or (totalTimeTaken > 5000))
